info.title: Ankr JSON-RPC, paid per call
info.description: Ankr blockchain JSON-RPC for agents, paid per call in USDC. No signup, no API key.
info.x-guidance: POST one JSON-RPC 2.0 request to /<chain>. Without payment the call answers 402 with the price on x402 and MPP; pay it and repeat the call. Prices by method, and which methods are free, are published at GET /pricing.
